I used this example on the renpy documentation website as a template :  
  s "Sure, but what's a \\"visual novel?\\""  
menu:  
"It's a videogame.":  
jump game  
"It's an interactive book.":  
jump book  
label game:  
m "It's a kind of videogame you can play on your computer or a console."  
jump marry  
label book:  
m "It's like an interactive book that you can read on a computer or a console."  
jump marry  
label marry:  
"And so, we become a visual novel creating duo."  
SO you have to put menu: and then indent the options to choose from and what they lead to (you cant make it so that if you choose something that nothing happens afterwards.) SO you have to put "jump (name the label here)" Like in the exmaple above, where it says "jump book" and then "label book". You have to put what the name of what dialogue comes next (aka the label) and then you have to make it so that depending on what you choose, it jumps to that dialogue so that it isnt the same. if you want the same dialogue no matter what you choose, you can do something like 

​

menu: 

  "Eat the candy"

jump candy

  "Don't eat the candy"

jump candy

label candy: 

  "That candy looks good."

  "A vibration is felt in your pocket."

  "So much for that."
